The Mayor presented the returns from the
Election held March 19 1883 For the officers of the Austin Fire Department which showed
August Zuehr Chief John P Kirk assistant chief and Charles Korfkuentz, Recorder.
The council confirmed the
officers elect of Austin Fire Department by acclamation

On Motion the Council adjourned
Thos L Purnell
City Clerk

Regular meeting of the City Council
Austin Texas April 4 1883
Hon W A Paylay Mayor Presiding

Roll call present aldermen Metz
Kenney Plath and Wilson,

absent aldermen Lawrence schuber
Brueggerhoff Radkey Hempking & Morlan

On motion the Council was called
and the marshal sent after the absentees

Aldermen Radkey and schuber came
in and answered to their names

On motion the Council
adjourned.
T L Purnell
City Clerk
